claim_summary: Plan ARIA-V6 — Autonomous Adapter Genesis via Convergent LLM Authoring + Lane-A Specialist Wiring. V5 wired the architectural shape (Gate A convergence + Gate B post-impl review) and universalized pedagogy to 81 agents, but operator's G1-G10 coverage audit revealed ~70% adapter gap and the capability_gap → skill_genesis loop still has 3 MANUAL gates (Draft, Sandbox, SHADOW→ACTIVE). V6 closes the gap via FOUR architectural moves: (D1) Gate C Lane-A specialist dispatch as a Tier-1 required kwarg on run_autonomy_orchestrator inserted between Gate A and worker_drainer, with deterministic pressure-driven specialist selection + cost cap + verdict-aggregation hallucination guard via Path.exists() against workspace_root; (D2) convergent_skill_authoring loop that makes adapter SOURCE CODE the product of a primary↔challenger debate bound to a Phase 0 evidence_pack (≥10 real file:line observations) with three CROSS-VERIFY gates (Path.exists + git show + snippet match) and judge-consensus exit at 100% calibration precision + recall>=0.90 + critical_FPs==0; (D3) operator-curated F-012-adapter-seeds.jsonl with 9 priority adapters that the V6.2 mechanism PRODUCES (NOT hand-coded); (D4) auto-promotion under narrow safe conditions (autonomous profile + min_precision>=0.95 + min_clean_cycles>=5 + critical_FPs==0 + evidence_chains_valid) via auto_promote_token, operator_approval path UNCHANGED. Three Tier-1 constraints derived from operator vision: 100% validation as structural exit, evidence-grounded debate (no hallucinated rule space), mutual hallucination guarantee.

subfindings.title: V6.1 Gate C — Lane-A specialist dispatch wiring (specialist_review_runner Tier-1 required kwarg + deterministic selection + verdict-aggregation hallucination guard)
subfindings.resolution_note: Plan ARIA-V6 Phase 6.1 (Commit C1) Tier-1 architectural wiring. specialist_review_runner REQUIRED kwarg on run_autonomy_orchestrator (no default, no Optional annotation per V5 §A1 precedent — I-V6-01 signature invariant). specialist_review_runner.py provides SpecialistReviewRunner Protocol + SpecialistReviewResult TypedDict + select_specialist_agents() deterministic algorithm (domain touch-map × cross-cutting × profile gate × cost cap) + transform_specialist_output() markdown→findings transformer with Path.exists hallucination guard (B-V9-1 fix — verified refs keep declared severity, unverified-only downgrade to MEDIUM) + run_specialist_review_runner() default impl + select_specialist_review_runner(profile) factory. R-A9 fixture compat applied to V3.3 + V5.1 + V5.2 invariant tests + tests/test_autonomy_orchestrator.py (all 44 regression tests green).
